source.name: Barrage Blow
source.originalDescription: Machamp gains increased movement speed by 10%, Attack by 25%, Defense by 300, and Sp. Defense by 300 for 8s before unleashing an unstoppable combo attack that continuously shoves enemies in the area of effect. Increases Machamp's movement speed by 5%, Attack by 30%, Defense by 200, and Sp. Defense by 200 for 10s. If used again, unleash a combo attack, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and shoving them. The final blow deals double the damage of the previous hits. Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 35% Attack Speed, 20% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Barrage Blow は 相手を押し出す、妨害無効になる、防御・特防を変化させる、シールドを付与する、再使用・派生・2段目を持つ。
